newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fresh probe targets former aide of France's Chirac.
newsitem.headline: Fresh probe targets former aide of France's Chirac.

text.p: A Paris state prosecutor opened a fresh probe on Wednesday into the former personnel director of President Jacques Chirac's Gaullist RPR party, on suspicion she was paid for fictitious work, justice sources said.

Louise-Yvonne Casetta, who was regarded as an unofficial fund-raiser for the party, was formally placed under investigation on suspicion of misusing corporate funds in a separate investigation last month.

The fresh probe is to investigate a monthly salary of 25,000 francs ($5,000) which she is alleged to have received from 1991 to 1994, from two companies, CIEC and Comatec, involved in public tenders with Paris' RPR-led municipality, the sources said.
Casetta denied any wrongdoing when questioned about possible links between RPR funding and public works contracts in the probe which led to her being placed under investigation.

In a another investigation targeting the RPR, Xaviere Tiberi, wife of Gaullist Jean Tiberi, who succeeded Chirac as mayor of the capital, was placed under investigation last month on suspicion of misusing public funds.
Investigators say they suspect her of having been paid 200,000 francs ($40,000) for a 36-page report largely copied out of a book.
